infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Huzz Live uses your camera so your match can see you during a random live session.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Huzz uses the microphone for Live video chat and club voice spaces.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Huzz needs your location (city/region) to show nearby matches and keep the community safe. Location is required to use the app.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Huzz needs access to your contacts for safety and to block people you know. Contacts access is required to use the app.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Huzz needs photo library access so you can add profile photos and share images in chat. Storage access is required to use the app.
